_meta.description: Saved LLM readings so the demo can run with no network. Offline mode looks a text up here by its exact body; a text that isn't here can't be read offline, so the agent asks Gloria (it never guesses). Only trusted senders' texts need a reading: strangers' texts never reach the LLM.
_meta.source: Same output the live model (openai/gpt-oss-120b) gave in scripts/eval_llm.py on Nov 24, 2026

readings.body: Mom can you get Ava at 2:30 tomorrow instead of 3:15? Early dismissal.
Hi Mom, Ava says thanks for the cookies 🍪
